content:
natalie: heads-up — customer flagged a short-lived provisional billing spike during a canary test. looks like ephemeral prefetch heartbeat + truncated toolcall replay caused overlapping provisional emits.
omar: can you paste session/trace id?
natalie: session=acct-721, trace=tr-71f. happened 2026-03-24T08:24:00Z. console provisional=192 confirmed=96. two provisional writes within 250ms from different hosts.
ochloe: this is the claim-race we've discussed. router grace-window currently 600ms; if a client reconnects and hits a different host before lease expiry we can get double provisional.
ops-bot: [alert] provisional-spike acct-721 count=192 confirmed=96 :warning:
omar: short term: modify alerting to not fire on provisional-only spikes unless confirmed increases within 2 minutes. that stops customer wakeups.
ochloe: agree for hotfix. medium term: add claim_nonce and claim_origin to provisional events and dedupe in ingestion by (session, claim_nonce). also add Seen cache TTL 30m.
natalie: good. can we also emit provenance in the per-session trace view so SREs can inspect which host emitted the provisional?
omar: yes, backend will add claim_origin and claim_nonce fields to billing events and expose /internal/billing/prov?session=acct-721&window=1h. will rate-limit to avoid abuse.
ochloe: router change: generate claim_nonce on first provisional emission and attach to heartbeats; prefetch sidecar must propagate it on retries. ingestion will skip duplicate nonces and log skips. pseudo: SELECT claim_nonce, COUNT(*) cnt FROM billing_events WHERE session_id='acct-721' AND event_time > now()-interval '1 hour' GROUP BY claim_nonce HAVING COUNT(*)>1;
natalie: owners: omar=router+ingest changes, chloe=console/alerting UX. timeline: alerting hotfix today, router flag to canary tomorrow, ingestion dedupe early next week. i'll add runbook note: "provisional spike -> call /internal/billing/prov -> check duplicate claim_nonce -> escalate if >1".
ops-bot: [deploy] alerting-hotfix deployed to canary 10:12 :rocket:
omar: i'll open PR for claim_nonce field and a small dedupe cache. thanks all.
